headline: A second quiet day; scores ease slightly
body: Another day with no scored events. The board drifted only by hundredths as earlier stories counted for a little less each day: Protector God, Enslaved God and Descendants eased slightly, while 1984 edged up. Horizon Balance is 2.9, down 0.01.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.05 and Enslaved God -0.05.
